text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just when Mejiro Ardan and I have completed the day's training regimen…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: May I run a little while longer, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You see, one of my classmates said she experienced something otherworldly on the track after sundown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Apparently, she heard footsteps closing in on her from behind while she was running. When she looked around, though, there was nobody there…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: There is that saying, "A fearful heart sees devils in the dark"… but I'd quite like to discover the source of these supposed footsteps.
choice_data_list: Too much running. I can't let you do that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Then I take it I have your permission? Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall inform you tomorrow as to whether I've encountered any specters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, Mejiro Ardan continues running laps around the track well into the night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I see your point. Insufficient rest can lead to injury after all. I shan't run for the rest of the day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Instead, I'll ascertain any supernatural goings-on while doing my cool-down stretches and icing my joints.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Mejiro Ardan's investigation fails to turn up any ghosts, it at least proves a good alternative to excessive training.
